props.name: allowClear
props.description: Show a pointer clear affordance when a value is selected.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: closeIcon
props.description: Icon used by the clear affordance.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close after selection. Defaults to true for single, false for multiple.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial popup state.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default value of the input (uncontrolled).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the input is disabled.

props.name: emptyRender
props.description: Custom renderer for the empty state when current filtered result has no matches.

props.name: id
props.description: The ID of the input element.

props.name: isItemDisabled
props.description: Additional disabled policy evaluated against the current selection.

props.name: items
props.description: Source items, optionally grouped. Item values must be unique within the collection.

props.name: itemToLabelString
props.description: Machine-readable text for matching; does not change visual labels.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon shown before the input/value area.

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the select is in a loading state.

props.name: loadingIcon
props.description: Icon shown during loading state.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the input element, used for form submission.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called when clear is triggered.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when popup state changes.

props.name: onReset
props.description: Post-reset notification after an unprevented native form reset.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled popup state.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown when no value is selected.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the input is read-only.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the input is required.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon for the dropdown trigger.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value of the input (controlled).

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary item description.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether this item cannot be selected.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading item icon.

props.name: label
props.description: Visual label.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique selection and form value.
